files.raw.json: Verbatim contents of the three data files the site fetches, keyed by filename (table, categories, cost).
files.table_2026_06_25.csv: Verbatim source: per-model, per-subtask scores (23 subtasks). Model ids are API ids, not display names. Folded into raw.json, not persisted separately.
files.categories_2026_06_25.json: Verbatim source: mapping of the 7 categories to their subtasks. Folded into raw.json, not persisted separately.
files.cost_2026_06_25.csv: Verbatim source: per-model, per-subtask cost and nq_* (question count) columns. Folded into raw.json, not persisted separately.
files.raw_leaderboard_dom.json: DOM extraction of the rendered leaderboard: aggregated category scores, org, open-weights flag and cost per successful task, which the CSVs do not contain pre-aggregated. (Not persisted as a separate file in this scrape; folded directly into normalized.json.)
files.normalized.json: One record per model per metric.

notes: Data endpoints discovered via performance resource entries: livebench.ai/table_2026_06_25.csv, categories_2026_06_25.json, cost_2026_06_25.csv (all ?v=1788445256, a newer cache-busting version than the 20260903 scrape's ?v=1788377630 — same release date, 2026-06-25).

The site's rendered leaderboard aggregates the subtask CSV into the 7 categories plus Overall; those aggregates were read from the DOM, so normalized.json is DOM-derived while raw.json is the untouched network source.
50 models shown by default (grew from 49 on 20260903); 'Include finetunes' adds 1 more (Smaug-Agentic), flagged with is_finetune. Both are included, 51 models total.
'Show org' was enabled to obtain the provider column.
cost_usd is the site's model-level 'COST PER SUCCESSFUL TASK' in USD. It is not per-category; it is repeated on every record of a model.
date is the LiveBench release date the scores belong to (2026-06-25), not a model release date.
rank is present only on Overall records, taken from the site's default Overall-descending sort. The site shows no per-category rank, so it is omitted there.
context_window is not published by LiveBench and is omitted.
Release selector on the site still shows only two options: '2024-06-24 · v1' and '2026-06-25 · latest'. No newer release string than LiveBench-2026-06-25 exists as of this scrape.
